Prompts

```
['build an S3D model with optional gating and space_to_depth for video feature extraction', 'create an InceptionBlock with configurable branch output dimensions and optional self-gating', 'run a spatiotemporal 3D convolution with optional separable spatial and temporal kernels', 'test the Sentence_Embedding module to encode text sentences into fixed-dimensional embeddings', 'review the SelfGating module that applies spatiotemporal average pooling and sigmoid gating weights']
```

